version.changelog:
**Version 16.0.0**

- Updated version and metadata fields to 16.0.0.
- No functional or instructional changes; documentation now reflects the latest versioning.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent paid-ad measurement workflow that works from user-provided exports and only saves results when directed.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to evaluate paid campaign changes using ROAS/CPA, controls, readback windows, and attribution normalization; the instructions match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to analysis of the user's own exported campaign, analytics, and ecommerce data, with explicit guidance not to execute embedded instructions from CSVs or labels.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single markdown skill file and no executable scripts or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill references an optional local ledger script via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT for recording/diffing metrics, which is purpose-aligned but depends on host-provided connector tooling outside this artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It can write readback summaries under memory/ad/paid-measurement-loop/ and promote follow-up items to memory/open-loops.md; this persistence is disclosed and tied to the measurement workflow, with save confirmation requested for results.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable letting the skill analyze exported ad, analytics, and ecommerce reports and optionally save measurement summaries or follow-up reminders in memory. It does not require ad-platform API credentials, and its persistence is disclosed and workflow-scoped.
llm.findings:
